In today’s episode, we sit down with Vinh Giang, communication Skills Coach & Keynote Speaker, a former magician who went from hiding in a school toilet, unable to speak English, to teaching the world how to communicate.
We discuss the 5-minute video audit that exposes your blind spots, why your accent isn’t the real problem, why quiet talent gets passed over, the five hand gestures that signal authority, and the four ways to truly listen.
